cards.title: Rank Changes by Edit Block
cards.paragraph: `parseDiff` now splits each hunk into contiguous changed-line blocks, and `applyRules` and model scoring rank blocks individually before `deriveHunk` aggregates their labels, attention, and score. `inert-audit.ts` reports inert edit blocks instead of hunks, while `rankWithModel` uses `Result` helpers to capture scoring failures and cache-save errors.

cards.title: Type Hunk Edit Blocks and Summaries
cards.paragraph: `Hunk` now includes derived `blocks`, `labels`, `attention`, and `score` fields. The new `EditBlock` type records each contiguous run of changed lines by ID, hunk ID, path, line-index bounds, optional old/new line ranges, labels, attention, and score.

cards.title: Typing refactor across 4 files
cards.paragraph: 9 edits change types, annotations or function form only (Hunk, blocks, hunk); runtime behaviour is unchanged.

cards.title: Test edit-block splitting and ranking
cards.paragraph: Tests verify that hunks split into edit blocks with correct ranges and stable IDs, and that `isolateBlock`, `blockText`, and `deriveHunk` handle block content and aggregate rankings. Model-ranking tests now expect questions and attention scores per edit block, while checking that each hunk inherits its highest-ranked block.

cards.title: Rename across 3 files
cards.paragraph: 7 edits rename identifiers (block, hunks, refs); behaviour is unchanged.

cards.title: Document Error Handling Rules
cards.paragraph: PLAN.md now specifies that expected recoverable failures use `Result<T, E>` or a value carrying a warning, while programmer errors and impossible states throw. It assigns conversion of throwing library calls to `attempt`/`attemptAsync` at call sites and reserves catch-all handling in `cli/main.ts` for mapping errors to exit codes.

cards.title: Document Hunk-Based Edit Blocks
cards.paragraph: The data model now places `EditBlock`s on `Hunk.blocks`, with `from` and `to` indexing `hunk.lines` and optional `oldRange` and `newRange`; hunk labels, attention, and score derive from its blocks. `Review` no longer includes a separate `blocks` field.
